lineage.description: Population in Need (PiN) figures were calculated by the Early Recovery Cluster using a standardized methodology that assesses severity levels across Colombian municipalities. The dataset aggregates needs assessments with quality control checks on data completeness and inter-annual variation to produce final PiN estimates disaggregated by administrative divisions and population groups.
